FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 321
Committee: Tourism Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/31/2023
Senate Bill 321 as introduced creates wholesaler and retail licenses to be issued by the
Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Board, to distribute and sell mixed spirit beverages, which
could increase receipts to the State General Fund by an estimated $44,300 and increase receipts
to the Board by an estimated $5.5 million to issue the following licenses in the following
amounts:
License Type Fee
$550, $200 for each additional
Mixed spirit beverage wholesaler license
warehouse
$1,000, $200 for each additional
Beer, wine, and mixed spirit beverage wholesaler license
warehouse
Limited mixed spirit beverage expanded retail license $500
Further, this bill levies a privilege or excise tax on the volume of sales of mixed spirit beverages
at $.98 per 12 fluid ounces or fractional part thereof which would be distributed as follows:
• State General Fund - $0.65 per 12 fluid ounces
• ABC Board - $0.10 per 12 fluid ounces
• Alabama Law Enforcement Agency / ABC Board - $0.15 per 12 fluid ounces
• Treasury of the municipality or county where sold - $0.08 per 12 fluid ounces.
According to the Board, estimated tax receipts generated from this new tax levy would generate
$3.9 million for an estimated loss of $890,000 annually.
Finally, this bill would increase the obligations of the ABC Board by a board estimated $1.2
million to implement and administer the online responsible vendor program course of
instruction for employees of retail licensees free of charge.
